name: Allison Ross
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Allison Ross — Specialist Couples Therapist & Registered Counsellor About My Practice Allison Ross is a highly qualified Counsellor and Specialist Couples Therapist with over 12 years of experience supporting clients through the intricate dynamics of love, connection, and personal growth. Her practice is built entirely on the principles of inclusivity, safety, and respect, welcoming individuals and couples across all sexualities, genders, neurotypes, cultures, and lived experiences. Her individual practice focuses on helping clients build self-esteem, master assertiveness, and process the long-term impacts of childhood trauma or family estrangement.

name: Becky Wanyoike
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: I am Becky Wanyoike with over 12 years experience, passionate about helping individuals navigate life's challenges and achieve greater wellbeing. my areas of expertise include trauma, relationships issues, grief and general life stressors. I utilize a person-centre approach, which means I believe you have the capacity for growth and self-healing. our sessions focus on creating a safe and supportive space for to explore your thoughts, feelings, and experiences. Together, will work collaboratively to develop strategies and tools to empower you on your journey towards a more fulfilling life.
